discrepancy.handoff_claim: LAB-SERVE-001b handoff/report stated total_slots=4, n_ctx=8192 shared, kv_unified=true (per slot 8192).

root_cause.summary: kv_unified=true is set ONLY in the auto branch (params.n_parallel < 0). The 001b argv passed --parallel 4 EXPLICITLY, so the auto branch was skipped and kv_unified stayed at its default (false). With kv_unified=false, per-sequence context = n_ctx / n_seq_max = 8192/4 = 2048. The earlier manual '8192' probe was on an AUTO server (no --parallel), where kv_unified=true makes per-seq context = full n_ctx = 8192.

source_citations.meaning: auto-4 + kv_unified applies ONLY when --parallel is NOT passed

source_citations.code: if (cparams.kv_unified) { n_ctx_seq = n_ctx; } else { n_ctx_seq = n_ctx / n_seq_max; n_ctx_seq = GGML_PAD(n_ctx_seq,256); ... }
source_citations.meaning: non-unified KV statically partitions n_ctx across n_seq_max sequences
default kv_unified is false in llama_context_default_params

root_cause.capture_bug_note: The blocks.json 'n_ctx: null' is a topology()-capture defect, NOT a server anomaly: the code read props.get('n_ctx') but /props has NO top-level 'n_ctx' key (only default_generation_settings.n_ctx). The effective per-slot value 2048 WAS correctly captured in default_gen_n_ctx and slot0_n_ctx.

empirical_confirmation.method: Started the pinned llama-server twice with the exact 001b MoE base argv; captured full startup log + raw /props + raw /slots. Files in this directory: topology_server_start.{explicit_parallel4,auto_noparallel}.log, topology_props_raw.*.json, topology_slots_raw.*.json.

explicit_parallel4.startup_log: srv load_model: initializing, n_slots = 4, n_ctx_slot = 2048, kv_unified = 'false'

auto_noparallel.startup_log: srv load_model: initializing, n_slots = 4, n_ctx_slot = 8192, kv_unified = 'true'

reconciled_values_for_001b_config.sharedKvCapacity: NOT shared — KV statically partitioned: 4 fixed cells of 2048 (= 8192 aggregate)

reconciled_values_for_auto_config.sharedKvCapacity: 8192 shared dynamically across up to LLAMA_MAX_SEQ sequences
reconciled_values_for_auto_config.maximumContextForFourActiveSlots: up to 8192 shared (sum of concurrent sequences bounded by 8192)

impact_on_001b_validity.verdict: VALID — every 001b request (1152 tokens worst case) fit inside the 2048 per-slot envelope with margin. Under kv_unified=false the 4 slots are statically partitioned, so at N=4 each slot independently retained its full 2048 with no cross-slot contention; no request could have been context-truncated. No measured 001b metric changes. The only correction is DESCRIPTIVE: the 001b topology was '4 slots x 2048, partitioned, kv_unified=false', not '8192 shared, kv_unified=true'.
impact_on_001b_validity.pairing_unaffected: Both MTP arms (on/off) ran the identical topology (explicit --parallel 4, kv_unified=false, 2048/slot), so the paired on-off deltas are unbiased by this misdescription.

consequence_for_001c.warning: effectiveSlotContext=2048 under the 001b config is TOO SMALL for the 001c coding class (8k-16k input + up to ~2k output = up to ~18k tokens/request). 001c MUST pin a larger context envelope. Options: (a) kv_unified=true with n_ctx sized for aggregate concurrent demand, or (b) larger --ctx-size with --parallel so each partition >= ~18k. Memory feasibility on the 24GB 3090 (MoE Q4 + q8 KV + n-cpu-moe 8) to be established by canary in Stage 2 before pre-registering load points.
consequence_for_001c.do_not: Do NOT reuse the 2048/slot envelope for 001c coding prompts.
